messages:
Maya (Product): Quick design check — I'm exploring a right-hand sidebar for prompt-set details during eval runs. Idea is collapse-by-default, persistent approvals CTA, and quick diff preview. Screenshot: https://img.redwood/mock/sidebar-v2.png

Liam (Design): Love the persistent CTA, but worried about clutter when many prompt-sets are open. Could we make the sidebar sticky only on wide screens? :thinking_face:

Sam (Engineering): Implementation note: sticky + streaming tokens might cause repaint jank on low-end devices. We can throttle reflows, but that adds complexity. Are we ok with a narrower feature rollout?

Maya (Product): Good point. Proposal: enable sticky on >= 1024px and fallback to a dismissible floating button on <1024px. That keeps mobile clean.

Liam (Design): Sounds reasonable. Also proposing a visual affordance for 'current diff anchor' — a small pill that says "Showing 1 of 4 diffs" with prev/next. Helps when users jump around.

Aisha (Accessibility): A few a11y nits:
- The sidebar close button needs a clear accessible name (use aria-label="Close prompt details").
- Ensure focus trap when sidebar is open for keyboard users; ESC should close it.
- Color contrast on the diff pill is borderline (we should hit 4.5:1).

Nora (QA): Repro note: when I opened two eval runs simultaneously I saw the approval CTA flash before the run finished streaming — could cause accidental approvals. Maybe disable CTA until run state is 'complete' or add a 2s debounce?

Maya (Product): Good catch. I prefer disabling the CTA until status === "complete" and showing a tooltip: "Approval disabled until run finishes". That reduces mistakes.

Liam (Design): Copy tweak for the CTA: instead of "Approve Prompt Set" try "Approve for deployment" or "Approve changes"? Thoughts?

Maya (Product): We want to be explicit about what approval means. "Approve changes" is too vague. I prefer "Approve prompt-set for rollout" — long though. Maybe shorter: "Approve for rollout".

Aisha (Accessibility): Copy length matters for screen reader verbosity. "Approve for rollout" is concise and clear. Also add aria-describedby referencing a short help text explaining what rollout entails.

Sam (Engineering): On the backend, we need a gate so that approval actions are idempotent — QA found duplicate requests when users double-click. We'll add server-side dedupe and client-side debounce of 800ms.

Nora (QA): I'll add regression tests:
- keyboard navigation to open/close sidebar
- focus stays inside while open
- CTA disabled during streaming and enabled at complete
- duplicate-click safety
I'll link the test cases in the ticket.

Liam (Design): Small visual nit: when the sidebar collapses to the icon strip, the icon spacing feels cramped. Recommend 8px -> 12px horizontal padding.

Maya (Product): Agreement on the majority. Action items:
- Liam: update mock with responsive states + diff pill (due EOD Thu).
- Sam: implement debounce + idempotency, and detect low-end repaint risk (PR by next Tues).
- Aisha: provide exact ARIA props and contrast target (by Mon).
- Nora: draft QA checklist and add to ticket (tomorrow).

Design-bot: New design iteration created: https://figma.redwood/PromptSetSidebar/v3 — comment thread created.

Sam (Engineering): One more thing — for the diff preview, can we lazy-load heavy diffs only when user expands the inline preview? Saves memory on large eval runs.

Liam (Design): Yes, lazy-load with a skeleton placeholder. I'll include that in the mock.

Maya (Product): Awesome. If no major objections I'll move this to the sprint board and tag design/eng for next-week work. :rocket:
